# [PR #14227] [None][test] Add verl post-merge E2E gates (0.5B convergence + 7B Megatron smoke)

source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/14227
state: open | updated: 2026-09-23T03:38:39Z
labels: 

## 正文

## Description

Adds two E2E training tests to the existing `DGX_B200-4_GPUs-Verl-Post-Merge-1` Jenkins stage, layered directly on top of #14037.

#14037 bumps the verl pin to `d324b01` and replaces the three file-level verl wrappers with 19 per-case wrappers. The verl pin is unchanged in this PR.

Until this PR, the verl post-merge stage only ran rollout unit tests; no end-to-end training test exercised the trainer ↔ rollout boundary owned by TRT-LLM.

This PR adds:

- **`test_e2e_convergence_qwen25_05b_grpo_trtllm`**
  - Runs 30-step GRPO on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct + GSM8K + TRT-LLM rollout.
  - Asserts:
    - `max(critic/rewards/mean) > 0.01` to verify a learning signal.
    - `max(actor/ppo_kl) < 0.1` to verify the trainer policy stays close to the rollout policy.
  - This catches weight-sync, dtype, and NaN-gradient regressions at the TRT-LLM rollout boundary.

- **`test_e2e_smoke_qwen25_7b_megatron_trtllm`**
  - Runs a 3-step Megatron actor + TRT-LLM rollout smoke test on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
  - Configuration:
    - Megatron actor: TP=2, PP=1
    - TRT-LLM rollout: TP=2
    - Script: `examples/grpo_trainer/run_qwen3_8b_megatron.sh`
  - Pass condition: subprocess exits with code `0`.
  - Exercises the most feature-loaded combination currently shipped by verl: Megatron + TP/PP + TRT-LLM.

## Stacking

This PR is **stacked on #14037**.

GitHub will show both commits in the diff until #14037 merges. After #14037 is merged, the diff will automatically recompute to only the eight files added or modified in this PR.

Please merge #14037 first.

## Walkthrough

This PR expands Verl integration testing by refactoring coarse pytest wrappers into fine-grained 1-to-1 test case mappings, introducing shared E2E utilities for trainer execution and convergence validation, and adding two new end-to-end tests targeting GRPO convergence and Megatron smoke testing. Configuration and test lists are updated to reflect the restructured test surface.

## Changes

**Verl E2E Test Infrastructure and Coverage**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Test utilities and fine-grained test wrappers** <br> `tests/integration/defs/verl/test_verl_cases.py`|Replaces coarse `test_async_server`, `test_adapter`, and `test_rollout_utils` wrappers with 19 fine-grained test cases. Adds module constants for rollout test paths, `_run_single()` to invoke individual verl cases by name, and three shared E2E utilities: `_run_verl_train()` for PPO trainer execution with combined stdout/stderr logging, `_ensure_gsm8k()` to locate or generate GSM8K parquet datasets, and `_check_convergence()` to parse trainer metrics and assert convergence/KL bounds.|
|**Fixture setup for E2E tests** <br> `tests/integration/defs/verl/conftest.py`|Re-exports `verl_setup` fixture from `test_verl_cases.py` so pytest's autouse behavior applies across sibling test modules in the directory, ensuring environment variables and module imports are available to E2E tests.|

Adds `test_e2e_smoke_qwen25_7b_megatron_trtllm()` that executes a 3-step Megatron-based training recipe via subprocess with TensorRT-LLM backend and resource settings tuned for 4-GPU CI.|
